SUBSTITUTE ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance, be amended by changing all of the B3-2,
Community Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 44 and 4-J

in the area bound by:

a line 53.75 feet north of and parallel to West 16" Street; South Sawyer Avenue; a line
28.75 feet north of and parallel to West 16" Street; the alley next east of and parallel to
South Sawyer Avenue; West 16" Street; and the alley next west of and parallel to South
Sawyer Avenue,

to those of a B2-1, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.
SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

Michael Scott Jr.
Alderman, 24" Ward

Common Address:
1554 S. Sawyer Avenue
1559 S. Sawyer Avenue
